drilling.pageHeading: Borehole & Core Drilling in Astana and Kazakhstan
drilling.pageSubtitle: Turnkey water well drilling, high-precision wireline core drilling, and engineering-geological boreholes with official technical passports.
drilling.p1: GeoExploration carries out turnkey water well drilling, wireline core drilling with high core recovery, and geotechnical investigation boreholes up to 250 meters deep across Astana, the Akmola region, and all territories of Kazakhstan. Our proprietary drilling fleet (all-terrain URB-2A2 rigs, Boart Longyear equipment) allows us to tackle complex geological conditions.
drilling.p2: All operations strictly adhere to Kazakhstan national standards: comprehensive geophysical logging, core and soil monolith recovery, installation of certified uPVC and steel casing, pumping tests, and full borehole passport issuance.

coreSection.title: Wireline Core Drilling (PQ / HQ / NQ Standard Recovery)
coreSection.description: Core drilling is essential for detailed stratigraphic investigation, mineral exploration, and geotechnical foundation assessments, recovering intact cylindrical rock specimens (cores) while preserving natural structural features. We deploy wireline double-tube core barrels with diamond crowns, delivering 95-100% core recovery even in fractured geological formations.
coreSection.bullet1: SSK (wireline) retrieval systems for continuous, uninterrupted core recovery
coreSection.bullet2: Storage in heavy-duty polypropylene core boxes with photo documentation
coreSection.bullet3: Laboratory testing of rock mechanical properties, density, and fracturing

stages.title: Borehole Drilling Workflow Stages
stages.stage1Desc: Review of local hydrogeological archives and on-site engineering assessment to locate the optimal drilling point.
stages.stage2Desc: Borehole drilling using selected methods (core, rotary, or auger) with real-time stratigraphic and aquifer logging.
stages.stage3Desc: Installation of casing strings, factory slotted screens, and clean gravel pack filtration zones.
stages.stage4Desc: Development pumping to clear water, static and dynamic water level testing, yield measurement, and official passport handover.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Drilling
faq.q1: What is the typical water well depth in Astana and the surrounding region?
faq.a1: In Astana and the Akmola region, sandy aquifers typically range between 25 and 45 meters, while deep artesian aquifers in fractured bedrock reach 60 to 120 meters. Precise depths are determined using geological maps and test boreholes.
faq.q2: When is wireline core drilling required?
faq.a2: Core drilling is mandatory for mineral deposit exploration and for geotechnical surveys supporting multi-story buildings and industrial infrastructure, where intact rock strength and fracture orientation must be analyzed.
faq.q3: Do you provide an official borehole technical passport?
faq.a3: Yes. Following drilling and pumping test completion, clients receive a full technical passport detailing exact borehole depth, geological cross-section, casing construction, water yield, and recommended pump specifications.
faq.q4: Do you work across all regions of Kazakhstan?
faq.a4: Yes, our mobile drilling crews with all-terrain 6x6 vehicles operate across all regions of Kazakhstan, including remote industrial and mining project sites.

hydrogeology.p1: Hydrogeological work includes the search and assessment of underground water resources. We conduct exploration drilling, pumping tests, determine well yield, and test water quality.
hydrogeology.p2: Based on study results, we develop a water intake well design with sanitary protection zone calculations and prepare all required permits and documentation.

core-drilling.title: Core Drilling
core-drilling.description: High-precision wireline core drilling with intact PQ/HQ/NQ sample recovery for exploration
core-drilling.details: Diamond and carbide core drilling with core recovery rates up to 95-100%. Extraction of rock core specimens in PQ, HQ, and NQ dimensions for stratigraphic analysis, rock mechanics testing, and mineral reserve estimation across Kazakhstan.

water-well-drilling.title: Water Well Drilling
water-well-drilling.description: Turnkey industrial and domestic water supply well drilling in Astana and regions
water-well-drilling.details: Full-cycle drilling of artesian and sand water wells in Astana and the Akmola region. Installation of steel and uPVC casing strings, slotted screens, pumping tests, hydrogeological reports, and official borehole passports.

geotechnical-drilling.title: Engineering-Geological Drilling
geotechnical-drilling.description: Borehole drilling for structural foundations with layer-by-layer soil monolith sampling
geotechnical-drilling.details: Field borehole drilling for residential, commercial, and industrial construction. Stratigraphic sampling of soil monoliths, in-situ field testing (plate load, SPT), and laboratory analysis adhering to Kazakhstan building codes.

engineering-geodesy.title: Engineering Geodesy & Support
engineering-geodesy.description: Geodetic support for construction, design and precision control
engineering-geodesy.details: Geodetic work at all construction stages: from axis layout to as-built surveys. Permanent geodetic presence on the construction site: monitoring axes, elevations, verticality of structures, and compliance with design decisions.

topo.title: Topographic Survey
topo.description: Creating topographic plans for design and cadastral work
topo.details: Creating topographic plans at scales 1:500 – 1:2000 for building design, utility networks, and site landscaping. Working with the national coordinate system.

stakeout.title: Staking Out
stakeout.description: Marking building axes and utility networks
stakeout.details: Transferring design coordinates to the ground: building axes, land parcel boundaries, utility routes. Fixing points on the ground with a stakeout report.

cadastral.title: Cadastral Survey
cadastral.description: Documentation for land and property registration
cadastral.details: Preparation of land surveying and cadastral documentation for property registration, lease, and other land parcel transactions.

facade.title: Facade Survey
facade.description: High-precision measurements of buildings and structures
facade.details: Measurement of building and structure facades for reconstruction, restoration, and design purposes. Creating facade drawings with architectural element details.

scan3d.title: 3D Scanning
scan3d.description: Digital models of terrain and buildings
scan3d.details: Laser scanning of objects and territories to create precise three-dimensional models. Used for BIM design, deformation monitoring, and architectural measurement.

landscape.title: Landscape Geodesy
landscape.details: Topographic work for landscape design: vertical planning, earthwork volume calculations, and landscaping project preparation.

vertical.title: Verticality Control
vertical.details: Determining deviations of building structures from vertical. Monitoring deformations of buildings and structures during operation.

geo-survey.title: Engineering-Geological Surveys
geo-survey.details: Full range of engineering-geological surveys: exploration well drilling, soil sampling, laboratory testing, and cone penetration testing. Technical reporting per SP and GOST standards.

tacheometry.title: Tacheometric Survey
tacheometry.details: Ground survey using electronic total stations for creating terrain plans, computing earthwork volumes, and compiling longitudinal profiles.

asbuilt.title: As-Built Survey
asbuilt.details: Recording the actual position of constructed buildings, structures, and utility networks. Compiling as-built drawings for commissioning.

field-supplies.title: Core Boxes & Sample Bags
